# Conversion pool (amendment 9; generated by `python -m src.conversion_pool`)

AAA pitchers outside the starter pool with >= 400 tracked pitches over the two pool seasons, scored with the amendment-5 baseline against the starter pool's mean and SD after a starter-equivalent adjustment. The primary picks stay with the starter pool. Backtest folds were already inspected (exploratory).
